note: Editorial tier: servers whose publisher and installation path were verified on 2026-10-31. The popularity column cites the community ranking (best-of-mcp-servers) or the registry, and never stands in for a claim about safety.

entries.name: GitHub MCP Server
entries.summary: Repositories, issues, pull requests and code search as tools. The remote server is hosted by GitHub and authenticates with a personal access token.
entries.why: Official GitHub server; the most-starred version-control entry in the community ranking (34k).

entries.name: Context7
entries.summary: Up-to-date library documentation on demand, so the model reads the current API instead of a remembered one.
entries.why: Most-starred documentation server in the community ranking (64k) and the first pick in two independent 2026 roundups.

entries.name: Playwright MCP
entries.summary: Browser automation over accessibility snapshots: navigate, click, type and read a page without image-based guessing.
entries.why: Official Microsoft server; the most-starred browser-automation entry (39k).

entries.name: Sentry
entries.summary: Issues, stack traces and releases from Sentry, read and triaged from the conversation.
entries.why: Official Sentry server with a hosted endpoint; the reference observability entry.

entries.name: Supabase
entries.summary: Projects, tables, migrations and logs of a Supabase project. Reads config and runs SQL with the project's own policies.
entries.why: Official Supabase server; the standard database pick in 2026 roundups.

entries.name: Firecrawl
entries.summary: Search, scrape and crawl the live web, returned as clean Markdown or structured data.
entries.why: Most-starred search-and-extraction server (7.7k) with an official SDK and hosted plans.

entries.name: Exa
entries.summary: Neural web search and page retrieval built for agents, with a hosted MCP endpoint.
entries.why: Official Exa server with a hosted endpoint; second most-starred search entry (5.2k).

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.summary: Workers, KV, D1, R2 and account configuration read and operated through Cloudflare's own MCP servers.
entries.why: Official Cloudflare server family; the largest cloud-platform entry by stars (4.4k).

entries.name: Grafana
entries.summary: Dashboards, datasources, Prometheus queries and alerts from Grafana, read inside the turn.
entries.why: Official Grafana Labs server; the most-starred monitoring-specific entry (3.6k).

entries.name: AWS MCP Servers
entries.summary: AWS's own suite: documentation, infrastructure-as-code guidance and service-specific servers for AWS work.
entries.why: Official AWS suite; the largest cloud listing by stars (9.9k).

entries.name: Notion
entries.summary: Search a workspace, read pages and create or update content in Notion.
entries.why: Official Notion server; the workspace pick named in the 2026 roundups.

entries.name: Linear
entries.summary: Issues, projects and cycles from Linear, read and updated where the work is tracked.
entries.why: Official Linear server with a hosted endpoint.

entries.name: Stripe
entries.summary: Customers, payments and documentation from Stripe; test-mode work stays in test mode.
entries.why: Official Stripe server; the payments entry with a hosted endpoint.

entries.name: Figma
entries.summary: Design files, components and variables from Figma, so the implementation reads the source of truth.
entries.why: Official Figma Dev Mode server; the design entry named in 2026 roundups.
